conviction_note: The half was pre-released on 6 Nov: revenue £33m, adj. EBITDA c.£3.0m, gross margin c.52%, cash £24m. The full-year EBITDA and EPS guide was held broadly in line with consensus, so the move lives in whether that guide survives. An independent series says China hog prices made a new low in November, against the Board's H2 China recovery (negative). The stock has drifted 8.4% below its post-warning close with no new negative RNS, and the last two interims rose 9.2% and 4.3% (positive). These offset, so p_up is 50 and the scaled number is 0. abs_move is 5.0, above the 3% pre-released base because this is a $0.1m/day name with 57% realised vol and a 6.2% median reaction. The findings sum to -0.6 and are not fitted to it.

findings.finding: China's national DLY live hog price fell to a new cycle low of CNY 8.60/kg on 6 Nov 2026, below April's 8.67. Mysteel expects sideways-to-lower prices through December. This cuts against the Board's 6 Nov assumption that China revenue improves in H2, which the reiterated full-year EBITDA guide depends on: H2 must make c.£5.5m EBITDA, flat on H2 FY26, with China down by roughly half.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: China-driven guidance cuts have hit this stock hard: -21.65% on the 1 Oct 2024 trading update and -12.1% on the 6 Nov 2026 update
findings.why_not_priced: The 6 Nov RNS used MARA wholesale pork prices only to 1 Nov and framed them as recovering from the June low. The live-hog new low came after the RNS. If the market had fully priced a China H2 miss, the shares would trade near an EBITDA-cut valuation. The 8.4% post-update drift is consistent with partial pricing, which is why this is sized small. It is macro-to-company transmission, and the company has not said it.
findings.independence: Trading Economics' November 2026 China food CPI update has pork still -10% y/y (https://tradingeconomics.com/china/food-inflation/news/599316, search snippet only). The company's own week-to-1-Nov wholesale figure, -13.8% y/y and 6% below the September peak, is in the 6 Nov RNS.

findings.finding: Since absorbing the 6 Nov warning (83.5p close), the shares have slid to 76.45p (-8.4%) on thin volume. The only RNS since were two positives: the ECOVAXXIN MG EU filing and the Aivlosin Saudi/Oman sales start. A reiteration of the 6 Nov EBITDA/EPS guide on 30 Nov therefore lands on a lower price than the one that priced it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Interims that followed a China warning rose: +9.16% on 28 Nov 2024 after the -21.65% warning of 1 Oct 2024; last year's interims +4.26% (1 Dec 2025)
findings.why_not_priced: A reiteration is what the company already guided, so this is sized near zero. The only thing not priced is that the price fell after the guide without any new company-level news. Had the market believed the guide, the shares would have held around 83p.
findings.independence: The precedent comes from the baseline's observed RNS reaction history (https://www.investegate.co.uk/company/EAH). No different source points the same way.
